The captures were put to the maintainer before this recommendation and the maintainer confirmed the position reading in their own words (issue345_comments.md; sheets_REPORT.md lists the four sheets). A is recommended first because it removes the dominant term and #346's streak together (analysis_REPORT.md §4 A), and B is held because the clear exists for the round-2 stale-byte class (analysis_REPORT.md §4 B, [VSE-23]).
